description: Dataset from structural health monitoring of a steel bridge in Sweden is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors John Leander, Jacob Nyman (KTH Royal Institute of Technology). The dataset consists of sensor data from the Vänersborg Bridge in Sweden, comprising 64 bridge opening events registered as accelerations, strains, inclinations, and weather conditions. Data from before, during, and after a verified fracture are provided. The sample of raw data captured the same bridge opening event multiple times over the monitoring duration. Coverage: national (SE); the metadata date the deposit to 2023. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support building-stock, asset and facility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
